color-no-hex.message: Use a --plt-* token: raw colours belong in tokens.css and the themes.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use a --plt-* token (color-mix() with tokens is fine): raw colours belong in tokens.css and the themes.

declaration-no-important.message: Avoid !important; if it must win over a utility, add a comment: stylelint-disable-next-line declaration-no-important.

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Fonts come from the theme: use var(--plt-font-*).
